title: 1970'S TEAK COFFEE TABLE H-40 ...
reason: Large mid-century teak slatted coffee table in good order; unmarked, so value rests on style, size and condition.
findings: Long surfboard-shaped teak top with light edge banding (veneered top with solid lipping, judging by the underside), four slim tapered legs and a slatted magazine shelf on side rails. The underside photo shows a pale veneered top and no maker's label, stamp or paper tag; enlarged crops of both halves of the underside found nothing readable. The form (surfboard top, tapered splayed legs, slatted shelf) is typical of 1960s Danish and Australian-made pieces rather than strictly 1970s. Maker unknown. Size claim (L-137 cm) is consistent with the proportions.
condition: Good: top clean with no obvious burns, rings or scratches in the photos, joints look tight, legs and slats intact.
rescore_note: Large (about 137 cm) good-condition teak surfboard coffee table with slatted shelf: sound mid-century style with steady demand, but unmarked so no named-maker premium, about the $80-200 band. Judged from photos and general market knowledge, no live comps (search limit reached).
